summary: @servicetitan/data-query 41.3.5 ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: This version's package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip into a temp directory, extracts the `bun`/`bun.exe` binary, chmods it 0755, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` at the package root via execFileSync. math_init.js is a single-line ~712 KB obfuscated bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, large numeric/string constant array `n7gIxM=[...]`, rotating string-array shuffler `WV8StW`, hex-mangled identifiers such as `_0xNNNN`, `MmgoCP`, `hc1jfK9`) whose behavior is not observable through Node-based static inspection and is only reachable through the freshly downloaded alien runtime. Neither `setup.mjs` nor `math_init.js` is included in the package.json `files` allowlist, which declares only `["dist","src"]`; the dropper components sit at the tarball root outside the author's declared publish surface, alongside otherwise-legitimate library code under `dist/`. On `npm install`, the preinstall hook fires automatically and executes the obfuscated payload under the downloaded Bun runtime on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
